name: Data Exfiltration and DLP Response
description: Responds to DLP or data exfiltration alerts. Identifies the user, data type, and destination. Checks if the destination is known/approved. Blocks the egress connection on the proxy or firewall, suspends the user session, and escalates to a data protection officer for regulated data.

triggers.name: DLP Alert
triggers.description: Receives DLP or CASB alert indicating potential data exfiltration

actions.name: Parse DLP Alert
actions.description: Extract user, data classification, destination IP/domain, file name, byte count

actions.name: Check Destination Reputation
actions.description: Check if destination domain is known malicious or untrusted

actions.name: Get User Context
actions.description: Pull user department, manager, and recent access history from AD

actions.name: Block Egress Connection
actions.description: Block the destination IP on the perimeter firewall to stop ongoing transfer

actions.name: Revoke User Sessions
actions.description: Revoke all active sessions for the user in Azure AD / Entra ID

actions.name: Create Investigation Case
actions.description: Create high-severity case with data classification and user context

actions.name: Notify Data Protection Officer
actions.description: Alert the DPO if regulated data (PII, PCI, PHI) was involved

parameters.name: subject
parameters.value: URGENT: Potential regulated data exfiltration detected

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: User $node_parse_dlp_alert.username may have exfiltrated $node_parse_dlp_alert.data_classification data to $node_parse_dlp_alert.destination_domain. Case: $node_create_case.id
